summary: Own lazy optional-module loading and contribution registration for one enabled experiment and window.

faults.when: A registered optional module failed to load; preserve the ordinary Studio and offer Try again.

lifetime: While the effective experiment preference and root-window demand remain true; disabling immediately aborts registration and all feature work.
x-catalogue: Platform experiment metadata includes ID, label and a lazy loader; Hair Lab code is not statically imported by registry, views, renderers or exporter composition.
x-disable: Ignore late dynamic-import completion after abort; withdraw registered nodes and UI contributions. JavaScript modules already imported may remain cached until page reload.
